info.biography: 张鲁的祖父，东汉丰县（今江苏徐州丰县）人。道教创始人。因其最初创立的五斗米道又称天师道，故又称张天师。
info.characteristic: 回合外防御力较强，可以封印关键角色的手牌。

records.o: 锁定技，你计算与其他角色的距离-1。当你于回合外受到伤害后，你判定，若结果为红色，你视为对伤害来源使用一张【杀】。
出牌阶段限一次，你可以摸一张牌，然后将一张手牌置于一名没有“箓”的其他角色的武将牌上，称为“箓”，其不能使用和打出与“箓”类型相同的牌。当其受到伤害或于弃牌阶段弃置至少两张与“箓”类型相同的牌后，将“箓”置入弃牌堆。

rulesMapping.huqi: Locked outgoing distance -1. Each actual positive received damage outside its owner turn issues one native judgment; only its final frozen red result can issue one native virtual Slash to that actual damage source. Source-less damage still judges but has no Slash target. Dead or illegal targets are skipped. An issued judgment/Slash opportunity survives source skill loss; native child returns restore suspended parent attacks and Duel continuations.
rulesMapping.shoufu: One activation per actual Play phase draws one first, then selects one entity from the current hand and another living globally talisman-free recipient. Store it in a public source-aware general pile. Restrict Use and Response by final effective Basic/Trick/Equipment kind, not physical payment category; delayed tricks are Trick. Pile and restriction survive the issuing Shoufu source losing skills or dying. Actual received damage releases after native dying handling. Two true same-category discard receipts during the same actual Discard phase release, summed across batches by movement sequence and actual phase token, never by card IDs or current discard-pile contents.
rulesMapping.interpretationBoundary: Current official hero and public client texts agree. No separate current official FAQ was found. Timing, final effective category and source lifetime follow native rule semantics; no claim of a separate FAQ revision.
rulesMapping.claimedJudgment: Huqi retains the native final frozen judgment suit even when Tiandu or another genuine final-judgment effect has already claimed the entity. Its local cleanup only moves a still-Processing judgment card; an entity in the claimant hand stays there. An exhausted no-card judgment skips the counterattack without fabricating a face.

validation: Root integrated focused verification passes all three native behavior checks: actual talisman entity/source lifetime, effective Use/Response category ban and true discard phase receipts; red/black native counter-Slash, source loss, cold replay and actual Tiandu claim without stealing the judgment entity back.
